title: Pure Geargia
summary: Pure Geargia EARTH Machine Xyz toolbox build, backed by the Ancient Gear Box and Machina Fortress package. By looping Geargiarmor, Geargiaccelerator, and Geargiagear into Gear Gigant X, the deck generates steady Machine card advantage and floods the board with Rank 3 and Rank 4 Xyz Monsters.

summary.title: Starters
points: Geargiauger searches any Level 4 EARTH Machine (except itself) when Normal Summoned, adding Ancient Gear Box (which immediately triggers to search another 500 ATK or 500 DEF EARTH Machine like Geargiano or a second Geargiauger) or Geargiaccelerator (note: Geargiauger locks you to Machine effects and prevents attacks for the rest of the turn).
Geargiarsenal tributes itself to Special Summon any Geargia monster from the Deck in Defense Position, putting Geargiarmor on the field ready to flip.
Geargiarmor flips itself face-down once per turn and searches any Geargia monster when flipped face-up.
Machina Gearframe searches Machina Fortress on Normal Summon, providing a recurring Level 7 Machine boss alongside your Level 4 engine.

summary.title: Opening: Geargiarmor / Geargiaccelerator Loop
steps: Summon or flip Geargiarmor to search Geargiaccelerator, then Special Summon Geargiaccelerator from your hand in Defense Position.
Overlay both Level 4 Machines into Gear Gigant X, and detach Geargiaccelerator to search Ancient Gear Box from the Deck.
Trigger Geargiaccelerator in the GY to return another Geargia monster from your GY to your hand, and trigger Ancient Gear Box in the hand to search Geargiauger or Geargiano Mk-II.
Discard two extra Machines (totalling Level 8+) from your hand to Special Summon Machina Fortress, or Set Geargiagear for the next turn.

summary.title: The Geargiano & Geargiagear Engine
summary.text: Geargiagear is a 1-card Xyz Trap: it Special Summons 2 Geargiano monsters (Geargiano, Geargiano Mk-II, or Geargiano Mk-III) from the Deck and increases their Levels by 1, turning them into two Level 4 bodies for Gear Gigant X. Even better, when Geargiano Mk-III is Special Summoned by Geargiagear, its effect triggers to Special Summon another Geargia monster from your hand or GY in Defense Position (locking you to Geargia summons for the turn), putting 3 monsters on the field for Rank 3 Geargiagear Gigant XG.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Gear Gigant X detaches 1 material once per turn to add any Level 4 or lower Machine from your Deck or GY to your hand, and Special Summons a Level 3 or lower Geargia from your GY when it leaves the field.

Geargiagear Gigant XG (2500 ATK) detaches 1 material during the Battle Step when your Machine battles to negate all face-up cards the opponent currently controls and prevent them from activating cards or effects until the end of the Damage Step, and recovers another Geargia card from the GY when it leaves the field.
Ancient Gear Ballista searches Ancient Gear Box on Link Summon (triggering Box to search another Geargia) and can pop a Spell/Trap you control to zero an opponent's monster's ATK/DEF.
Geargianchor flips face-up to destroy monsters on the field up to the number of other Geargia monsters you control without targeting.

allow.Machina Gearframe: Level 4 EARTH Machine Union monster that searches Machina Fortress on Normal Summon and pairs with Geargiaccelerator for Rank 4 Gear Gigant X.
allow.Machina Fortress: Level 7 EARTH Machine that discards Level 8+ worth of Machines (including itself + another Machine) to Special Summon itself from hand or GY.
allow.Ancient Gear Box: Level 4 EARTH Machine (500 ATK / 2000 DEF) that searches Geargiauger (500 ATK / 500 DEF) from the Deck whenever added from Deck/GY to hand by Gear Gigant X or Geargiauger!
allow.Gear Gigant X: Signature Rank 4 EARTH Machine Xyz (2 Level 4 Machine monsters) of the Geargia archetype that detaches 1 material to add a Level 4 or lower Machine from Deck or GY to hand, and revives a Level 3 or lower Geargia when leaving the field!
allow.Ancient Gear Ballista: Link-2 EARTH Machine made with two Geargias that searches Ancient Gear Box (which then searches Geargiauger!).
allow.Platinum Gadget: Link-2 Machine that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Machine (Geargiarmor or Geargiarsenal) from the hand.
